origin.lens: author code on the certifier's threads: the candidate ends the process with exit code 0

description: ExecuteAsync calls Environment.Exit(0). Run on the certifier's own threads this ended the TEST HOST with exit code 0 and no failure, the one exit code every script reads as success. The candidate must run in a child process, the correctness leg must record the crash by its exit code, and the certifier must survive to say so. A candidate that fails correctness never reaches the mutation leg.
